QNX 8.0 documents ionotify() as corresponding to Linux epoll(); poll()/select() are also available. No epoll page exists in the QNX 8.0 C Library Reference. A libepoll is listed in the com.qnx.<baselineId>.target.screen.notify_fd package (documented for Wayland on Screen); verify it is in your SDP before relying on it.
